title: A local map of complete Noetherian local rings has a flat Cohen presentation
statement: Let $\varphi:(A,\mathfrak m_A)\to(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings such that $A$ is $\mathfrak m_A$-adically complete and $B$ is $\mathfrak m_B$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then there are Noetherian complete local rings $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ and a commutative square of local homomorphisms $R\to S$, $R\twoheadrightarrow A$, $S\twoheadrightarrow B$, $A\to B$ in which the vertical maps are surjective and $R\to S$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complete-local-map-regular-presentation] to the given local map f. Obtain complete regular local rings R and S, surjective local maps q and b, and a local flat map g with b composed with g equal to f composed with q. Regular local rings are Noetherian local rings by definition [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Forget the residue-field isomorphism, parameter-system extension, and regular closed-fibre assertions, and assemble the remaining witnesses and conjunctions in the order of the statement. All universes and the original map f are unchanged.
